Priya: Heads-up team: scheduling a Dedicated rollout for NimbusHealth tonight 21:30 PT. Plan: warm reserved pool, shift 10% canary, validate KV cache warmup and latency, then promote to 100% if checks pass. Need final ops + SRE ack. @Rafael @Tess @Morgan
DeployBot: [deploybot] Rollout scheduled: nimbus-dedicated-v3 -> 2026-03-21T21:30:00-07:00. Canary stages: 10% (10m) -> 50% (10m) -> 100% (20m). RunID: db-roll-1762123456.
Rafael: Quick checklist request: where are the exact metric thresholds and emergency rollback commands? want to avoid ambiguity during noisy periods.
Priya: From playbook: rollback if: 1) 99th latency >120ms above baseline for 3m, 2) error rate >0.8% sustained 4m, 3) cold-start rate >0.5% for 5m. Emergency rollback CLI: `redwoodctl rollback --tenant nimbus --to-version v2 --force-drain`. Added to notes.
Tess: SRE ack, will watch the latency bands and cold-start metric. I also want a short lived sampling of golden prompts at each stage to check output quality.
Morgan: Ops ack. One KMS caveat: tenant key rotation is scheduled in two days, not tonight. I'll still toggle a KMS hold step pre-commit as a precaution.
Priya: Good catch. Add step in flow: `ops toggle-kms-hold --tenant nimbus --until 2026-03-23`. Will include contact for key-hold release.
DeployBot: Preflight summary for db-roll-1762123456:
```
capacity: OK (reserved pool 1.1x)
smoke-tests: 12/12 passed
kv-cache-warm: pending (will run at canary start)
config-verify: OK
canary-policy: 10 -> 50 -> 100
```
DeployBot: Dry-run canary (no traffic) succeeded. KV cache warmup probe scheduled at canary start.
Rafael: I edited the runbook to add an explicit probe command for cache warmup: `redwoodctl probe-kv --tenant nimbus --samples 100` and a note to wait 90s post-warm before measuring p99.
Tess: Acknowledged. Also added a soft-delay between 50% -> 100% stage: 2m observation window to reduce flapping.
OpsBot: Oncall rota pinged: oncall@infra (Tess) and ops@infra (Morgan) will be notified at rollout start.
Priya: Everyone acked? I need final GO/NO-GO by 21:15 PT.
Morgan: GO from Ops. I'll be on standby for kms hold toggle.
Rafael: GO from SRE. Watching golden prompts and p99.
Tess: GO. Monitoring decks ready.
Priya: Thanks. DeployBot proceed with schedule. If any rollback trigger fires, auto-halt and notify oncall; manual rollback requires two approvals. Logging post-rollout notes: capture KV warm time and small-signal latency spike at stage boundaries.
DeployBot: Rollout confirmed and queued for 2026-03-21T21:30:00-07:00. Notifications set.
Priya: Added final calendar invite + runbook link to the thread. Reopen this thread if anything changes. :rocket:
